about: Versioned retrieval expectations for the 15 frozen evaluation questions. 'filter' is the explicit date filter used for every before/after retrieval comparison, the same for both code versions, so date-parser changes can't look like retrieval changes. v1 is the answer key in docs/eval-questions.md as written; it is never edited. Later versions list only what they change.

v1.source: docs/eval-questions.md (T-014, frozen in T-020); filters from the original parser (v1-pre-improvement)
